goals: Verify the home page navigation bar displays correctly with expected content and a visible 'Login' link.
Verify that clicking the 'Login' link redirects the user to the correct login URL.
Verify that the search functionality accurately filters the displayed list items to show only the matching result.
activities: Assert that the navigation bar contains 'SPARQList'.
Assert that the 'Login' link is visible.
Assert that the current URL is '/-login'.
Get the initial count of list items.
Assert that the initial count of list items is greater than 1.
Assert that the first list item is visible.
Extract the ID from the first list item's href attribute.
Assert that the extracted ID is not empty.
Fill the search input field with the extracted ID.
Assert that only one list item is displayed.
Assert that the displayed list item has the correct href attribute.
